---
name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help us improve protype-code
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Input Source**
- [ ] PRD (Markdown / UTF-8 Text / HTML / DOCX)
- [ ] React Project AST (JSX / TSX)
- [ ] DOM Capture
- [ ] PrototypeSpec JSON (Merge / Conflict)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, e.g.:
```sh
npm run prototype -- --input <path-to-input> --id <id> --out <output-dir>
```

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Environment**
- Node.js version: (e.g. 22.18+)
- OS: (e.g. Windows 11, macOS, Ubuntu)
- Browser (if testing offline HTML): (e.g. Chromium, Chrome, Firefox)

**Additional context**
Add any other context, error logs, or snippets about the problem here.
